description: MainActivity.kt is the main entry point for the Android app, managing UI components, user interactions, calculator expression evaluation, history management, and theme toggling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing calculator UI, history drawer, theme toggling, and voice search integration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up event handlers, and prepares the activity state.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the displayed result based on the current expression.

methods.name: setupUndoRedoButtons
methods.description: Sets click listeners for undo and redo functionality.

methods.name: updateUndoRedoButtonStates
methods.description: Enables/disables undo and redo buttons based on current state.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and updates the display with the result or error.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Attaches event handlers to calculator keypad buttons to modify input or evaluate expressions.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Configures the history drawer toggle button and overlay.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Displays the history drawer with animation, populating it with stored history.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Hides the history drawer with reverse animation.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Populates the history drawer with past calculations, handles empty state, and sets up list item behaviors.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes history display if the drawer is currently visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles theme toggle menu item selection.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches app theme between light and dark modes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from speech recognition, delegating to VoiceSearchBar.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles runtime permission results, delegating to VoiceSearchBar.
